Decision - Product analytics vendor is PostHog Cloud (EU region)
# Product analytics vendor: PostHog Cloud (EU region)

Decided on 2026-10-14 by Maya Okafor and Tom Lindqvist.

## Decision
Product analytics vendor is **PostHog Cloud (EU region)**.

## Why
Self-hosted PostHog is consuming too much ops time; switching to PostHog Cloud reduces operational burden while keeping clinic data in the EU.

This replaces Decision - Product analytics vendor is PostHog self-hosted (f004a28).

## Context
Decision recorded from Tom Lindqvist message on 2026-10-14 and confirmed with Maya Okafor.

Decision - SMS reminder provider is Sinch (effective 2026-11-01)
# SMS reminder provider: Sinch

Decided on 2026-10-13 by the weekly sync attendees (Maya Okafor, Tom Lindqvist, Priya Raman, Daniel Reyes, Sofia Marchetti, Kenji Watanabe).

## Decision
SMS reminders will be provided by **Sinch**, effective 2026-11-01. Vonage is no longer used for SMS reminders.

## Why
Vonage has continued to fail on Portuguese numbers; the team agreed to migrate to Sinch to restore reliable delivery.

This replaces Decision - SMS reminder provider is Vonage (28e1671).

## Context
Action from the meeting: Kenji to stop the Vonage rollout. Priya to redesign SMS reminder templates for Sinch by 2026-10-30.

# Release cadence: twice-weekly releases (Tuesdays and Thursdays)

Decided on 2026-10-15 by Tom Lindqvist and Daniel Reyes.

## Decision
Release cadence is **twice-weekly releases**, scheduled for Tuesdays and Thursdays. Releases will remain behind feature flags.

## Why
Continuous deploys were surprising pilot clinics mid-day; a fixed twice-weekly schedule reduces disruptions while preserving feature-flagged rollout.

This replaces Decision - Release cadence is continuous deploys behind feature flags (316a7a9).

## Context
Customer comms prepared earlier for continuous deploys are completed; update comms to reflect the new schedule.

Update documentation and any design-system-dependent work accordingly.

Weekly sync 2026-10-13
# Weekly sync — 2026-10-13

Attendees: Maya Okafor, Tom Lindqvist, Priya Raman, Daniel Reyes, Sofia Marchetti, Kenji Watanabe

## Notes and decisions
- Launch recap: public launch occurred on 2026-10-06 as planned; early feedback from pilot clinics is positive.
- SMS reminders: team agreed to move SMS reminders to Sinch from 2026-11-01. Vonage will be discontinued.
- Support tool: Sofia proposed moving from Plain to Zendesk; Maya asked to see Plain's new pricing first. Revisit in December.
- Per-practitioner colours: several receptionists requested per-practitioner colours on the calendar (investigate/backlog).

## Actions
- Kenji: stop the Vonage rollout (task cancelled).
- Priya: redesign SMS reminder templates for Sinch by 2026-10-30.
- Maya: review Plain pricing and lead the revisit in December.

Recorded decisions and related tasks are linked below.

Decision - SMS reminder provider is Vonage

# SMS reminder provider: Vonage

Decided on 2026-10-02 by [[Tom Lindqvist]].

## Decision
SMS reminder provider is **Vonage**.

## Why
Messagebird delivery failures in portugal.

This replaces [[Decision - SMS reminder provider is MessageBird]], which is no longer current.

## Context
Accessibility review flagged low contrast on the cancelled-appointment chips. Support volume is highest on Monday mornings before 10am. Reception teams keep asking for fewer clicks when moving appointments.

Decision - Release cadence is continuous deploys behind feature flags

# Release cadence: continuous deploys behind feature flags

Decided on 2026-10-04 by [[Tom Lindqvist]].

## Decision
Release cadence is **continuous deploys behind feature flags**.

## Why
Weekly batches hid regressions.

This replaces [[Decision - Release cadence is weekly releases every Thursday]], which is no longer current.

## Context
Exports to CSV are used weekly by clinic managers for payroll. Support volume is highest on Monday mornings before 10am. Load testing showed the booking endpoint is fine up to 300 requests per second.

# Investor update cadence: fortnightly update with a metrics dashboard link

Decided on 2026-08-16 by [[Priya Raman]].

## Decision
Investor update cadence is **fortnightly update with a metrics dashboard link**.

## Why
Brightpath wanted more frequent numbers.

This replaces [[Decision - Investor update cadence is monthly email update on the first Monday]], which is no longer current.

## Context
Reception teams keep asking for fewer clicks when moving appointments. Calendar sync with Google and Outlook still drops edits made within the same minute. Clinic owners care about no-show rates more than any other metric.
